verdict.rationale: React is an open-source library published on GitHub that you install into your own project. It runs entirely on your own infrastructure: in the browser, or on your own Node server for server rendering and streaming. Community discussion confirms it was relicensed to MIT, so there is no dependency on a vendor-hosted service. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the license and self-hosting terms in the pack (MIT status comes only from community comments), and any hands-on account of running it with no external dependencies.
